_note: Hand diagnosis of every question all six routes got wrong (2026-11-20). Labels: grader bug, verifier bug, wrong gold, model wrong. Science questions were checked against each route's first answer; instruction questions were re-scored with a corrected reading of each rule on the full answers; code answers were re-run against the tests with the error tolerance the task states.
mmlupro-3035: Every route answered C on the first try and the verifier accepted it; gold is F. Qwen is wrong.
mmlupro-7767: Tools, Deep, Vote and Vote+Tools answered D, Fast answered I, gold is F. Qwen is wrong; Deep+Tools and Vote+Tools also hit the token cap once.
aime-2002-II-4: Answers 627, 412, 601, 421 and 203 (Deep and Vote hit the 32,768-token cap); gold 803. Deep+Tools even claimed 601 is the official answer. Qwen is wrong.
gsm8k-train-5520: All routes answered 2400 = 1500 + 300 + 600, counting the old $300 card as a purchase. Gold 2100 = 1500 + 300 + (600 - 300): the upgrade costs the difference. Qwen is wrong.
rlvrif-10521: The instruction asks for 10 paragraphs separated by * * *; every route answered 'group V' in one paragraph (even with a corrected divider count). Qwen ignored the format rule.
rlvrif-5343: Asks for a postscript starting with 'Before I forget:' at the end. Deep and Vote put 'Before I forget:' at the very start, the others left it out. Qwen did not follow the rule (the checker's P.S.-only bug also applies, but no answer would pass a correct check).
rlvrif-74: Asks for a postscript starting with 'Before I forget:'. Deep+Tools and Vote put it at the very start, the others left it out. Qwen did not follow the rule.
gsm8k-train-2338: 10 bottles x 2 cups + 5 half bottles x 1 cup = 25 cups. Every route answered 25; the gold says 30.
gsm8k-train-1464: 'Three times more' read as 3 x 7000 x 31 = 651,000 by every route; the gold 868,000 uses 4 x 7000 x 31. The wording is ambiguous; Qwen's reading is the common one.
gsm8k-train-2882: Dexter used 3/8 and Jay 5/8 of one gallon, so nothing is left: every route answered 0. The gold 4 (litres) assumes each had a gallon, which the question does not say.
gsm8k-train-3588: Tripling each day for four days: start x 3^4 = 810, start = 10 (every route). The gold 30 uses three triplings.
gsm8k-train-5436: 5 products with 5 minutes between each: 4 waits = 20 minutes + 30 = 50 (every route). The gold 55 counts 5 waits; ambiguous at best.
lcb-abc337_e: An interactive problem (the program must talk to a judge). The stored stdin/stdout tests cannot judge it, so no answer can pass; Qwen's programs answered with fixed outputs.
math-train-prealgebra-724: Answers 3.5 and 3.50; gold '\$3.50'. The math checker does not strip the escaped dollar sign.
math-train-prealgebra-838: Every route answered 'Softball, Kickball, Picnic', exactly the gold '\text{Softball, Kickball, Picnic}'. The math checker cannot compare text answers.
math-train-precalculus-663: Answers (2/3, -2/3, -1/3): a unit vector orthogonal to both, the negative of the gold (-2/3, 2/3, 1/3). Both are correct; the grader accepts only the gold's sign.
math-train-counting_and_probability-582: The question says 'Type the letter'; every route answered C, which is 0.20, the gold value. The grader compares the letter with the value.
math-train-geometry-625: Every route answered A; option A is the gold expression bx/h (h - x). The grader compares the letter with the expression.
lcb-abc314_e: Float output. The task allows 1e-5 error; the grader compares text exactly (215.913355350494385 vs 215.913355350494384765625). With the stated tolerance Fast, Deep, Deep+Tools, Vote and Vote+Tools pass 15/15 tests.
lcb-abc315_f: Float output, task allows 1e-5 error, grader compares text. With tolerance every route that answered passes 15/15 (Deep hit the token cap twice, no answer).
lcb-abc324_f: Float output, task allows 1e-9 error, grader compares text (0.749999999999999 vs 0.75). With tolerance Fast, Deep+Tools, Vote and Vote+Tools pass 15/15.
